svg.title: Determine
svg.desc: Glasses that warn a cane user about obstacles at head height. A time-of-flight sensor and FreeRTOS firmware on the frame report distance over UDP; the phone answers with sound and a haptic pulse. Pictures: The prototype glasses at HackTX 26; Simulator with the real engine; Desktop app, system ready.
